title: TokTz-Ket-Dill
start: Talk to any of the three TzHaar at the collapsed tunnel in the south-east corridor of TzHaar City.

items.t: Adamant pickaxe or better (tool belt will work for the mines, but will only work for the fight if you already have a melee weapon equipped. Otherwise, bring a separate pickaxe for the fight)
A main-hand magic weapon and runes for water spells, or a necromancy weapon
A ranged weapon (the final lava monster can only be damaged with ranged)
A melee weapon (for faster breaking of the TokTz-Ket-Dill armour)
A necromancy weapon can be used to kill the fire and lava monsters. Cannot use necromancy for the last lava monster and the TokTz-Ket-Dill

recommended.t: Food for the final fight (portent of restoration does not work)
Varrock armour for mining the obsidian
Transportation to Varrock for quick access to the Varrock Palace library
TokKul-Zo for quick teleportation around TzHaar City
There are several banks in the city, so you do not need to bring all the items in the backpack.
A plank box can be used to carry the oak planks before being treated

kills.t: TokTz-Ket-Dill (level 64) (In-game guide is out of date)

rewards.t: Access to the TokTz-Ket-Dill mine with 1 silver rock, 8 coal rocks, 3 mithril rocks and 2 adamantite rocks (access is obtained after reaching the third dungeon; you don't have to kill the TokTz-Ket-Dill).
Ability to mine stone slabs (unsmithable obsidian) in the TzHaar obsidian mine
The possibility of watching TzHaar-Hur-Brekt's play

steps.t: After entering the TzHaar City, go east as far as possible along the southern wall, then directly north (just west of Fight Cauldron teleport). Speak to one of the three guards.  [Chat: 1 What has happened here? › Accept]
Talk to TzHaar-Ket-Grol south-west, at the crack in the wall (with at least one empty inventory slot). [Chat: 1 I was told to talk to you]
Enter the tunnel to the library north-west of the Main Plaza.
Speak to TzHaar-Mej-Lor. [Chat: 1 I need help with the TzHaar language.]
Talk to Reldo in the Varrock library about TzHaar language. [Chat: 3 I have a question about the TzHaar language.]
p: The 'books' in the back of the library

steps.t: Along the west wall, in the cluster of 3 bookcases, search the middle one for the TzHaar Tourist Guide.
Read the TzHaar Tourist Guide along with the note inside.
Return to TzHaar-Ket-Grol. [Chat: 1 I know what to bring now. › 5 A pickaxe. › 5 Oak planks. › 4 Blocks of stone.]
Go east and pass the cave entrance.

Enter the mine directly east and speak with TzHaar-Hur-Brekt on the east side [Chat: 2 Can you teach me magma mining? › 1 But it's very important!], then talk again. [Chat: 2 We should change the plot. › 3 The humans started it.]
p: The TzHaar cast of the play!

steps.t: Speak to TzHaar-Hur-Klag on the west wall. [Chat: 3 How can I make the story better? › 2 TzHaar who gets assaulted in its home is TzHaar-Hur. › 4 That was it.]
Speak to TzHaar-Mej-Kol, just north. [Chat: 3 How can I make the story better? › 2 One is a TzHaar-Mej who is aware of the situation. › 4 That was it.]
Speak to TzHaar-Xil-Mor, south-east in the mine. [Chat: 3 How can I make the story better? › 1 The criminal could be a TzHaar-Xil.]
Speak to TzHaar-Hur-Brekt. [Chat: 1 We should decide an ending. › 1 The criminal's plans are foiled.]
Speak to TzHaar-Xil-Mor. [Chat: 3 How can I make the story better? › 2 The plans aren't always foiled.]
Speak to TzHaar-Hur-Brekt. [Chat: 3 They are all happy with the plot.]

Speak with TzHaar-Ket-Jok, south-west in the mine. [Chat: 1 You will play the role... › 3 ...JalYt-Jenny › 2 What do you think of your current role? › 3 We should modify your current role. › 2 No, we can't have that. › 4 That was it.]
Speak with TzHaar-Xil-Mor. [Chat: 1 You will play the role... › 1 ...TokTz-Ket-Ek-Mack. › 2 What do you think of your current role? › 4 That was it.]

Speak with TzHaar-Hur-Klag. [Chat: 1 You will play the role... › 4 ...TzHaar-Hur. › 2 What do you think of your current role? › 3 We should modify your current role. › 1 Eh, I guess so. › 4 That was it.]
Speak with TzHaar-Mej-Kol. [Chat: 1 You will play the role... › 2 ...KetKul-Schmul. › 3 We should modify your current role. › 4 That was it.]
Finally speak to TzHaar-Hur-Brekt. [Chat: 2 Yes, all roles have been given out.]
Mine the Stone slab vein and craft 4 pillars for the first cave section (you can easily return for more).
Go to the quest start location and have your planks treated by the small TzHaar-Hur-Frok. [Chat: 1 Can you treat these oak planks for me? › 1 Here you go.].
Enter the crack in the south wall by TzHaar-Ket-Grol.
The first cave requires 6 treated planks and 4 pillars. After fixing the cave-ins, mine the blocked tunnel and proceed to the next checkpoint.
The second cave requires 6 treated planks and 6 pillars. The fire monster can only be harmed by magic with water spells or necromancy.

The third cave requires 2 treated planks and 7 pillars. The first two lava monsters can only be harmed by ranged weapons with an attack range of 5 spaces or higher or by using necromancy. You will need to use magic with water spells or necromancy on the final fire monster. You cannot cross the stones before killing all three lava monsters.
Once you are ready to fight the TokTz-Ket-Dill, enter the tunnel to the north. [Chat: 1 Yes.]

sub.t: If you die, your gravestone will appear in the chamber with the trapped TzHaar-Hurs, outside the tunnel to the TokTz-Ket-Dill.

steps.t: Kill the TokTz-Ket-Dill by breaking its armour with a pickaxe equipped, then using only melee attack. Do not use prayers until the shell is broken.
After killing the TokTz-Ket-Dill, exit to the north, head south out of the caves, and then talk to any of the three starting TzHaar to finish the quest.

get_inside.text: TokKul-Zo teleport directly to the Fight Cave, Fight Kiln, Fight Cauldron, Fight Pit, or city centre.
Fairy ring BLP is located near the Fight Cave.
Amulet of glory teleport to Karamja, then run west from the banana plantation to the main entrance atop the Karamja Volcano.
Karamja lodestone teleport, then run east from Brimhaven, through the members' gate, to the volcano.
